recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further work for this issue would target obsolete generated DSTU1 output or add redundant wording to current source that already captures the intended validation guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-3337 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 correction for FHIR-core ConceptMap asking that narrower mappings in generated conceptmaps.xml include comments, because the then-current schematron said narrower maps SHALL have comments and the generated example was invalid.
initial_application: Jira says the issue was fixed in svn revision 3980. The git-svn import has revision @3980 as commit 27c543be03 ('fix build to succeed'), but no durable current ConceptMap source hunk remains; the obsolete generated conceptmaps.xml artifact is not part of the current source tree.
additional_context: ConceptMap and HumanName are active current build inputs. Current ConceptMap relationship terminology uses source-is-broader-than-target/source-is-narrower-than-target rather than the DSTU1 narrower wording, and cmd-1 now carries the comment guidance as a best-practice warning for source-is-broader-than-target or not-related-to mappings. FHIR-26315 later challenged the R5 relationship changes and was resolved no-change.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit is needed because the cited HumanName old-to-v2 0200 mapping includes comments for NOUSE and BAD, and a scan of current non-test ConceptMap XML found no non-draft source-is-broader-than-target or not-related-to mappings lacking comments.

related_jiras.note: Later no-change challenge to R5 ConceptMap relationship semantics; useful background confirming the current source-is-broader/source-is-narrower model remains intended.
